overview: The Medford School Committee recognized the high school varsity rowing team, accepted a grant donation from the Medford Educational Foundation, approved capital expenditures for high school bathroom safety and maintenance, and passed the first reading of a district water wellness policy.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy and contract negotiations for the superintendent.

items.title: Recognition of MHS Varsity Rowing Team
items.summary: The committee recognized the Medford High School varsity rowing team for winning the state championship team trophy.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills and payrolls, capital purchases, grants, field trips, and meeting minutes from November 18, 2024.

items.title: DEI Subcommittee Report
items.summary: The committee approved the November 19, 2024 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Subcommittee meeting minutes following discussion on creating a dedicated district DEI position.

items.title: Strategic and Capital Planning Subcommittee Report
items.summary: The committee approved the November 26, 2024 Strategic and Capital Planning Subcommittee meeting minutes regarding school HVAC projects.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on Thanksgiving community drives, athletic achievements, upcoming music concerts, and kindergarten registration starting January 2.

items.title: In-Control Driver Safety Course Presentation
items.summary: District administrators and representatives presented an overview of the In-Control hands-on driver safety training program available to Medford students.

items.title: Medford Educational Foundation Donation
items.summary: The committee voted to accept an $8,755 donation from the Medford Educational Foundation to support teacher grant requests.

items.title: Medford High School Bathroom Update
items.summary: The committee approved $94,000 in capital funds for high school bathroom vape detectors, cameras, and cleaning equipment, and requested a staffing proposal for the supplemental budget.

items.title: Policy ADF-W Water Wellness Policy
items.summary: The committee approved the first reading of a district water wellness policy governing testing frequency and action plans for lead and copper levels in school water fixtures.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of former district administrative assistants Rita A. Muzuru and Mary Margaret McKinton.
